# Build, CI & Tooling — Mental Model

> Release/versioning → release-versioning.md. Agent doc endpoints → docs-agent-endpoints.md. CSS/theming → build-css.md. Bench regression → bench-regression.md. Demo layout → demos-layout.md.
> Read order for build failures: vite config → bundle budget → Nx config → CI pipeline.

## vite build ([libs/grid/vite.config.ts](libs/grid/vite.config.ts))

- OWNS: ES + UMD outputs (core + all-in-one), per-plugin builds, per-feature builds, theme distribution, `__GRID_VERSION__` injection.
- INPUT: `src/index.ts`, `src/all.ts`, `src/lib/plugins/*/index.ts` (auto-discovered), `src/lib/features/*.ts` (auto-discovered), `libs/themes/*.css`.
- OUTPUT: `dist/libs/grid/` → `index.js`, `all.js`, `lib/plugins/*/index.js`, `lib/features/*.js`, `umd/*.umd.js`, `themes/*.css`.
- INVARIANT: plugin scan auto-discovers from `src/lib/plugins/` (excludes `all/`, `shared/`). `plugins/shared/*` is inlined into each importing plugin bundle (never its own chunk).
- DECIDED (Oct 2026; bundle composition global rule, see development-principles): per-plugin builds route `src/index.ts` public value exports PER SYMBOL → `@toolbox-web/grid`/`TbwGrid`; internals/literal consts inline. WHY: path-depth/regex rules left ~60 undefined `TbwGrid.<internal>` reads and duplicated mutable state; plugin ESM −6…−8 kB.
- INVARIANT: module state (top-level `let`, `const x = new Map|Set|WeakMap|WeakSet()`) has ONE runtime copy — build fails if a plugin keeps it while core has it (`index.js.map` sources) or 2+ plugins keep it (`assertSingleStateCopy`). Fix: `@internal` export from `public.ts`. Check reads Rolldown `chunk.modules[id].code`; terser sourcemap `names` are empty. Runtime proof: `bundle-check/smoke-dist.mjs`.
- DECIDED (#504): a plugin's HARD dependency on another plugin is imported statically from that plugin's INDEX (`import { HierarchyPlugin } from '../hierarchy'`). ESM: `externalizeCore()` maps it to external `@toolbox-web/grid/plugins/<dep>` (resolved path must be `lib/plugins/<dep>` ≠ own, ≠ `shared`) — consumer bundler includes it once, no runtime load step. UMD: no external rule for it, so it is INLINED into the dependent `.umd.js` (tree/grouping-rows +~1.2–1.7 kB) — deprecated, removal tracked in release-versioning.md. Optional deps are never imported.
- INVARIANT (#659): published `.d.ts` relative specifiers MUST be ESM-valid (`./x.js`, `./x/index.js`): `"type": "module"` + Node16/Next otherwise drop `export *`, widen named exports to `any`, lose augmentations, or raise TS2834. `bundler` emits extensionless → grid/react/vue `dts.afterBuild` uses [tools/vite-dts-esm-specifiers.ts](tools/vite-dts-esm-specifiers.ts) (AST rewrite; fails unresolved; composes changes into existing `.d.ts.map` files). It also intersects Vue SFC `ComponentOptionsBase` global component/directive types with their `Record` constraints (TS2344). Angular N/A (ng-packagr flattens).
- INVARIANT: UMD global naming `"pinned-rows"` → `TbwGridPlugin_pinnedRows`.
- DECIDED: parallel plugin/feature builds in the `writeBundle` hook with pre-created directories (race avoidance); ES only for plugins (no CJS); each entry self-contained (`manualChunks: undefined`); all comments stripped.
- DECIDED: terser inlines constant property accesses (`GridClasses.CELL_FOCUS` → `"cell-focus"`) — using `constants.ts` has ZERO bundle overhead vs raw strings.

## bundle budget ([tools/vite-bundle-budget.ts](tools/vite-bundle-budget.ts))

- RUNS IN: Vite `closeBundle` (after all sub-builds). Raw + gzip via zlib.
- BUDGETS: core `index.js` ≤170 kB raw / ≤50 kB gz hard fail, ≤45 kB gz soft warn; plugins ≤50 kB each (**editing 55 kB** — the `commitCellValue` surface); adapters react ≤50 kB, vue ≤50 kB; grid-angular fesm ≤276 kB (`libs/grid-angular/project.json` `bundle-check`).
- INVARIANT: `warnSize`/`warnGzip` never fail the build; `maxSize`/`maxGzip` fail with exit 1 under `severity: 'error'`.
- POLICY: design target 45 kB gz, hard ceiling 50 kB. Any new code pushing core toward 50 kB MUST first try a plugin extraction — land in core only if a plugin would damage performance (hot path, render scheduler, virtualization).
- INVARIANT: `cssBrowserTargets` = documented floor (`chrome123 edge123 firefox121 safari17.5`, tracks `platform.mdx`) on BOTH `css.lightningcss.targets` (transform) AND `build.cssTarget` (minify) in every `build()`. Vite runs lightningcss twice; old targets re-prefixed `mask-*`/`user-select` for unsupported browsers.
- DECIDED (Nov 2026, #592 investigation): force `Features.Nesting` lowering despite native browser support. WHY: native nesting increased wide-grid style recalculation; same-JS 4× CPU A/B best render 649→550 ms (released 574 ms). `vite.config.ts#cssConfig`; browser CSSOM guard in `performance-regression.spec.ts`; computed-style parity: 0 differences across 218 elements/pseudos.
- INVARIANT: `terserOptions.compress.passes: 3` in every build; no hand CSS prefixes. RULED OUT: `unsafe_*`/`pure_getters` (≤0.2 kB gain), core-only `mangle.properties` (cross-plugin property contract; renaming EVERY `_` prop saves only 0.79 kB gz), shortening prose strings (all core prose ≈0.8 kB gz), `#private` names (already mangled to 1–3 chars). What works: deduping near-identical blocks (dump a file's minified output with `bundle-check/dump-source.mjs`) — #642 pass: −3.8 kB raw ≈ −0.6 kB gz (gz yield ≈ 1/6 of raw: gzip already eats repetition).
- DECIDED (#259): `forbiddenSymbols` (`{ path, symbols: string[], reason? }`) fails the build if a listed substring appears in the matched file — asserts the shell controller tree-shakes OUT of core `index.js`. Signal: public ShellPlugin METHOD names `openToolPanel`/`registerHeaderContent`/`unregisterHeaderContent` (property names survive terser). RULED OUT: `tbw-shell-header` (core `dom-builder.ts` emits it), class names (mangled), `getToolPanels` (substring leaks into core).

## ci pipeline ([.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml))

- FLOW: setup (detect release merge) → validation (lint + test + build + bench, parallel) → e2e (build all → start 4 demo servers with `USE_DIST=true` → Playwright) → release-please → build-docs → deploy-pages.
- INVARIANT: e2e runs against `dist/` (validates release packaging).
- INVARIANT: release-please merge commits skip validation (already passed on the feature branch).
- INVARIANT: `bench` job runs parallel, gated only on `setup`, **NOT** in `release-please.needs` — informational, never blocks a release merge.
- INVARIANT (e2e diagnosability): failing Playwright output MUST reach stdout: `bun run e2e` uses `--output-style=stream`; configs use `['list']` for raw test output and `['github']` for failure annotations; the custom reporter writes only `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`; artifact includes root + docs-e2e reports and `test-results/`. See `run-e2e` skill.
- INVARIANT (#659): CI runs `grid-vue:typecheck-nodenext` after builds; [fixture](tools/typecheck-nodenext/consumer.mts) checks declarations with NodeNext + `skipLibCheck:false` and `@ts-expect-error` sentinels. Grid/react/vue build targets and `grid:test` hash the helper.
- INVARIANT (coverage): all libs write `coverage/libs/<project>/coverage-summary.json`; `grid-{react,angular}` `project.json` `coverage.reportsDirectory` OVERRIDES the vitest config (a dead `test-output/` CI path once skipped their reports silently); it resolves against the vitest root (= project root) → `../../coverage/…`, never `../../../` (PR #545 Nx 24 migration slip). [tools/coverage-report.ts](tools/coverage-report.ts) → ONE sticky PR comment; thresholds mirror vitest configs.
- GOTCHA (#531): captured (non-TTY) Nx condensed output drops a passing task's report — scripts parsing Nx output MUST pass `--output-style=stream` + strip the `<project>: ` prefix (`lint-baseline/lint-warning-diff.ts` read 0 of 268 warnings until fixed).
- INVARIANT: `USE_DIST=true` affects only the **demo** apps (`demos/shared/resolve-aliases.ts`). `apps/docs` picks source-vs-dist from `isProductionBuild` in its own `gridAliases()`, and `docs-e2e` runs `astro dev` → docs-e2e always tests **source**, never `dist/`.
- INVARIANT (perf self-comparison): root `e2e` script serializes `e2e`/`docs-e2e` (`--parallel=1`), but each suite still uses 4 CI workers (`fullyParallel`): perf tests share 4 vCPUs with each other and with functional tests. Wide-render/churn comparisons use `measureInterleaved` (alternate local/cdn and first-page order); builders clear prior grids. Retries/interleaving mitigate contention, not real stylesheet cost; profile before weakening the 1.1 gate.
- DECIDED (#665): `measureInterleaved` judges the MEDIAN OF PER-PAIR RATIOS over 15 pairs after one discarded warm-up pair; it returns `cdn` = median CDN sample and `local` = `cdn` × that ratio. WHY: single cycles of identical code spread 45–118 ms unthrottled (heavy right tail), so best-of-3 `min` per side swung 0.70–2.29× and flagged 6/12 attempts under full load. The paired median flagged 0/14, yet caught an injected +30% slowdown 8/8, unloaded and loaded. Both tests are `test.slow()` (16 pairs × 3 attempts). Failures list every attempt. RULED OUT: running the perf spec in a dependent Playwright project (skipped whenever any functional test fails), and a pinned CDN version (does not address the noise). Procedure: `run-e2e` skill.
- DECIDED (visual baselines = trunk-seeded Actions cache, not committed): `e2e/snapshots/` gitignored; main/2.x `TBW_VISUAL_MODE=write` saves key `visual-baseline-<os>-chrome<major>-<sha>`; PR restores newest prefix. `updateSnapshots:'none'` always; write captures only `REFERENCE_DEMO` PNG, others compare. Never global `'changed'`/`--update-snapshots` (parity specs share names; last demo overwrote #497). PR reads main cache; immutable SHA + Chrome-major keys; missing baseline graceful. TENSION: trunk regression becomes baseline; intentional change → `skip-visual` + rerun.

## grid-angular ng-packagr (Bun dual-package hazard)

- INVARIANT: feature secondary entry points (`libs/grid-angular/features/*/src/index.ts`) MUST NOT `import type { TemplateRef } from '@angular/core'` directly when calling `adapter.createTrackedEmbeddedView(...)`. Use the type inferred from the helper (`getDetailTemplate`, `getResponsiveCardTemplate`) which comes from `@toolbox-web/grid-angular`.
- TENSION: under Bun, `@angular/core` resolves twice during secondary entry-point builds — `node_modules/.bun/@angular+core@<hash>/` (local imports) vs `node_modules/@angular/core/` (what the built adapter `.d.ts` references). The two `TemplateRef`s differ only by the private `_declarationLView` brand → `Types have separate declarations of a private property`.
- DECIDED (May 2026): do NOT use `as unknown as TemplateRef<...>` in feature bridges — it hides the mismatch in one direction and breaks on the next `.d.ts` rebuild. Files: `features/master-detail/src/index.ts`, `features/responsive/src/index.ts`. The cast is still acceptable inside the main adapter (`angular-grid-adapter.ts`) where both endpoints resolve through the same package instance.
- DECIDED (Jul 2026, `link-grid-dist` must repoint BOTH node_modules): adapters declare `@toolbox-web/grid` as a VERSIONED dep, so `bun install` drops the published (stale) grid into `libs/grid-*/node_modules/@toolbox-web/grid`, which SHADOWS the workspace-root symlink (**ng-packagr uses Node module resolution**). [link-grid-dist.ts](tools/link-grid-dist.ts) junction-links BOTH paths → `dist/libs/grid`. SYMPTOM if only root is linked: `TS2305: '@toolbox-web/grid/plugins/*' has no exported member '<NewType>'` for post-publish API. RULED OUT: stale `dist/`, Nx cache, vite-plugin-dts emit. A passing React/Vue **build** is NOT proof a grid type resolves (esbuild strips types) — only ngc + the `typecheck` targets (matrix below) type-check.
- DECIDED (Aug 2026 audit M3): the script is SHARED and parameterized — `bun run tools/link-grid-dist.ts <adapter-dir>`, with a `link-grid-dist` target on all three of `grid-angular`, `grid-react`, `grid-vue` (each `dependsOn` `grid:build`; `typecheck`/`build` depend on it). WHY React/Vue too even though Vite honours tsconfig `paths`: the stale copy still misleads every Node-resolution-based tool (fallow, ESLint resolvers, IDE go-to-definition). The old `libs/grid-angular/scripts/link-grid-dist.ts` is deleted.
- INVARIANT: `linkToDist()` MUST stay idempotent and retry on `EEXIST`/`ENOTEMPTY`/`ENOENT`/`EPERM`. All three adapters write the SAME workspace-root `node_modules/@toolbox-web/grid`, and Nx runs their `link-grid-dist` targets in PARALLEL — the old check→`rmSync`→`symlinkSync` sequence let a peer win in between (CI-only `EEXIST`, run 31183787525). Never remove an entry that already resolves to `dist/libs/grid`: another adapter may be resolving through it.

## nx config (nx.json)

- Plugins: `@nx/js/typescript`, `@nx/vite/plugin`, `@nx/vitest`, `@nx/eslint/plugin`, `@nx/playwright/plugin`.
- Named inputs: `production` excludes test + `.bench.ts` files; `sharedGlobals` = `ci.yml`, `tsconfig.base.json`, `vitest.config.ts`, `bun.lock`.
- TENSION: `ci.yml` in `sharedGlobals` means any CI change invalidates all caches.
- DECIDED (Jul 2026): `targetDefaults` sets `cache: true` + `inputs` for `build` / `typecheck` / `test`; `bench` is `cache: false` (timings must be re-measured). WHY: `libs/*/project.json` hand-declares these targets with an explicit `executor`, which SHADOWS the inferred `@nx/vite/plugin` / `@nx/vitest` targets and silently drops the plugins' built-in `cache: true`. Symptom was zero cache hits on test/build while lint (inferred, not shadowed) cached fine. Measured: build 92s→13s, test 73s→9s, lint 24s→4s.
- INVARIANT: a hand-written target in `project.json` inherits NOTHING from the matching inferred plugin target. Set `cache`/`inputs` explicitly or add `targetDefaults`; inputs must include consumed repo files outside `projectRoot`.
- INVARIANT: cached targets consuming generated dependency outputs MUST include them via `dependentTasksOutputFiles` in `inputs`; `dependsOn` orders producer tasks but does not add their file contents to the consumer's inputs.
- INVARIANT: any `tsc`/`vue-tsc` target that resolves `@toolbox-web/grid*` (paths → `dist/`) MUST declare `dependsOn: [{ projects: ["grid"], target: "build" }]` itself. Listing both `typecheck` and `grid:build` under `build.dependsOn` is NOT enough — Nx runs `dependsOn` entries in PARALLEL, so `<adapter>:typecheck` can start before `grid:build` emitted `.d.ts`. SYMPTOM: 100+ `TS2307: Cannot find module '@toolbox-web/grid/...'` plus cascading `TS7006` / `TS4112` / `TS2339` noise. Fixed Jul 2026 in `libs/grid-react/project.json`.
- GOTCHA: CLI flags are part of the task hash, so `bun run test` (`--silent`) and a bare `nx test <proj>` keep SEPARATE cache entries. Alternating between the two looks like cache instability; it is not.
- DECIDED (Aug 2026): root `test` script pins `--parallel=2`. At Nx's default 3, each concurrent project spins up its own vitest fork pool and Windows spawn latency trips `[vitest-pool]: Failed to start forks worker … Timeout waiting for worker to respond`. SYMPTOM is deceptive: every reported test file passes, but the FILE COUNT is short (grid-vue 27/33, grid-react 29/37) and Nx exits non-zero with those projects in `Failed tasks:`. Diagnose by comparing the per-project file count against a solo `nx test <proj>` run before assuming a real regression.
- INVARIANT: root `package.json` MUST keep `typescript-eslint` in devDependencies. `@nx/eslint-plugin`'s flat configs `require("typescript-eslint")` but declare it in NEITHER `dependencies` NOR `peerDependencies`; removing it makes `@nx/eslint/plugin` `createNodes` throw → `NX Failed to process project graph` in EVERY Nx command. Passed locally (stale `node_modules` copy), broke every CI job on a fresh install (run 31181502277).
- INVARIANT (dep-pruning): before deleting a devDependency, verify against a FRESH install — `bun install` does not reliably prune, so `require.resolve` keeps succeeding locally. Check `grep -o '"<pkg>"' bun.lock` and grep `node_modules/@nx/**` for undeclared `require("<pkg>")`.
- TODO: `@nx/vite:build` executor is deprecated (removed in Nx v24) while `@nx/vite/plugin` is already registered. Migrate with `nx g @nx/vite:convert-to-inferred` — needs re-verification of the custom `vite.config.ts` plugin chain + bundle-budget plugin.
- INVARIANT (Astro 7 dev daemon): every `astro dev` invocation MUST clear `GIT_PAGER`. Astro 7's `am-i-vibing` matches `TERM_PROGRAM=vscode` **and** `GIT_PAGER=cat` (both set by EVERY VS Code terminal), forks a daemon, prints a JSON `"Dev server running at …"` line and exits 0 — `nx serve docs` looks successful with nothing in the foreground and a stray process on the port. No `--no-background` exists. Fixed via `env.GIT_PAGER: ""` in `apps/docs/project.json` `serve`, `apps/docs-e2e/project.json`, and `playwright.config.ts` `webServer.env`; the promo config uses `astro preview`.

## Typecheck coverage matrix

| Project        | `typecheck` target | Compiler                           | Why                                                                  |
| -------------- | ------------------ | ---------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `grid`         | ✅                 | `tsc --noEmit`                     | `@nx/vite:build` (esbuild) strips types WITHOUT checking             |
| `grid-react`   | ✅                 | `tsc --noEmit`                     | same                                                                 |
| `grid-vue`     | ✅                 | `vue-tsc --noEmit`                 | same; plain `tsc` cannot parse the 9 `.vue` SFCs in `src/lib/`       |
| `grid-angular` | ❌ by design       | ngc (inside `@nx/angular:package`) | ng-packagr type-checks during build → a separate target is redundant |

- DECIDED (Jul 2026): added `grid-vue:typecheck` via `vue-tsc` (devDep `vue-tsc@3`, TS 6.0.3) + wired `"typecheck"` into `grid-vue:build.dependsOn`. WHY: `grid-vue` was the only vite-built lib with zero type checking — errors surfaced only via vitest or the editor. Passed clean on first run.
- INVARIANT: `libs/grid-vue/tsconfig.lib.json` MUST keep `"src/**/*.vue"` in `include` or `vue-tsc` silently checks nothing but the `.ts` files.

- INVARIANT (#470): NO gate type-checks SPEC files. `grid:typecheck` runs `tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json`, which `exclude`s `src/**/*.spec.ts` / `*.bench.ts` / `__tests__/**`; vitest transpiles without checking and ESLint's rules are not `tsc`. A spec can carry a hard `TS2353`/`TS2322` while lint+test+build all pass; `tsc -p libs/grid/tsconfig.json` checks NOTHING (references-only, `files: []`). To check one by hand: `bunx tsc --noEmit --pretty false --ignoreConfig --strict --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --lib ES2022,DOM,DOM.Iterable --types node <file>` (`--ignoreConfig` is REQUIRED or tsc errors TS5112; ignore `TS2307` for `?inline` CSS and `editor`/`editable`/`lockPosition` augmentation noise).

## tsconfig paths (tsconfig.base.json)

- All map to `dist/` (built artifacts) for CI type checking: `@toolbox-web/grid` → `dist/libs/grid/index.d.ts`; `@toolbox-web/grid/plugins/*` → `dist/libs/grid/lib/plugins/*/index.d.ts`; `@toolbox-web/grid/features/*` → `dist/libs/grid/lib/features/*.d.ts`; `@toolbox/themes/*` → `libs/themes/*` (source).
- INVARIANT: `compilerOptions.paths` does **NOT merge** across `extends` — a child tsconfig declaring its own `paths` fully REPLACES the parent's. Same for `types` and `lib`.
- DECIDED: a child overriding one mapping (e.g. `tsconfig.typedoc.json` pointing `@toolbox-web/grid-angular` at source) MUST repeat every `@toolbox-web/grid*` parent mapping it still needs, using wildcards for compactness. Detection signal: a burst of `TS2307: Cannot find module '@toolbox-web/...'` from a child config with its own `paths` block → suspect path shadowing first.

## dependency clusters ([.ncurc.cjs](.ncurc.cjs))

Keeps `npm-check-updates` from proposing breaking upgrades. Default `target: latest`; cluster-anchored packages forced to `minor`; Nx + Angular toolchain `reject`ed (owned by `nx migrate`). Cluster: members (gate):

- Nx: `nx` == every `@nx/*`, byte-identical (rejected — only via `nx migrate latest`).
- Angular: `@angular/*` pinned 21.2.x via root `overrides`; `@angular-devkit/build-angular` + `ng-packagr` match major (rejected — `@nx/angular` 22.7.x supports Ng 20–21 only).
- TypeScript ceiling: `typescript` capped `<6` (Angular 21 + typescript-eslint 8).
- ESLint: `eslint` + `@eslint/js` held at 9 (typescript-eslint 8 / `@nx/eslint` lack ESLint 10).
- Vite/Vitest: `vite`, `vite-plugin-dts`, `@vitejs/*`, `vitest`, `@vitest/*` == `vitest` (`@nx/vite` 22.7.x → Vite 7).
- Astro/Starlight: `astro`, `@astrojs/*` (`mdx`, `markdown-remark`, `starlight`, `cloudflare`), `astro-mermaid`, `mermaid` (Starlight gates Astro AND the `@astrojs/mdx` major; `astro-mermaid` peer gates `mermaid`).
- Vue: `vue` + `vue-router`, demo-only.

- FREE (majors OK): `concurrently`, `jsdom`, `jsonc-eslint-parser`, `wait-on`, `happy-dom`, `pagefind`, `@types/node`, `typedoc*`.
- HARDENING: `majorLocked` entries ending in `/` (`@astrojs/`, `@vitejs/`, `@vitest/`) match by PREFIX via `isMajorLocked()` so new family members auto-lock.
- GOTCHA (post-#545 docs CI break): `minor` does NOT protect 0.x — Starlight 0.42 needs `@astrojs/mdx ^8`; root mdx stayed at 7, which pins `@astrojs/markdown-remark` 7.2.4 at root, but astro 7.4 / Starlight / mdx 8 take it as PEER `^7.3.0` → "`@astrojs/markdown-remark` is too old". RULE: root mdx major == Starlight's mdx dep major; keep `@astrojs/markdown-remark` an explicit root devDep. Hand-edited `package.json` + `bun install` may say "no changes" and skip the lock — use `bun add -d --exact`.
- GOTCHA: `apps/docs/package.json` has no deps, so Astro's `crawlFrameworkPkgs` never marks integrations `noExternal`; compiled-JS ones (Starlight ≥0.42; ≤0.41 shipped `.ts`) stay external → Node rejects `astro:*` (`ERR_UNSUPPORTED_ESM_URL_SCHEME`). Fix: `vite.resolve.noExternal` in `astro.config.mjs`; `vite.ssr.noExternal` misses Astro 7's `prerender` env.
- FLOW: `bun run update` → [tools/update-deps.ts](tools/update-deps.ts) sequences `nx migrate latest` + run-migrations → `bunx npm-check-updates -u` (**no `--target` flag** — a CLI flag would override `.ncurc.cjs`) → `bun install` → verify lint/test/build + `build (docs)` (root `build` excludes docs; only `astro build` checks the Astro cluster's peers). `bun run update:dry` reports only; `bun run update:full` adds both e2e suites (`e2e:full` + `nx e2e docs-e2e`). Never auto-commits; prints a rollback SHA on failure.

## workspace tooling (`tools/`)

- Root dev scripts live in `tools/`; per-project `scripts/` (`libs/grid{,-angular}/scripts/typedoc-to-mdx.ts`) stay project-scoped — do NOT hoist. Shared by 2+ projects → `tools/` (e.g. `link-grid-dist.ts`).
- ESLint covers `**/scripts/*.ts` + `tools/**/*.ts` (`enforce-module-boundaries` off). Most standalone tooling is not included in a TypeScript project or test suite, so execution does not provide semantic type checking. Exception: `tools/typecheck-nodenext/consumer.mts` is checked by `grid-vue:typecheck-nodenext`.
- DECIDED (Jun 2026, `watch-libs.ts`): spawn via `node:child_process` (`Bun.spawnSync` died exit 58 on Windows — same as bench); changed dir → single Nx project (`libs/themes` → `grid`), `nx build <project>` cache ON; `pending` Set re-flush drains mid-build edits; yalc-push only the rebuilt project.
- DECIDED (Jun 2026): `bench-vs-tag.ts` lives in `.github/skills/bench/` (backs the skill); `tools/merge-bench-runs.ts` + `tools/compare-benches.ts` stay in `tools/` (CI calls them). `ROOT = resolve(import.meta.dirname,'..','..','..')`. No `package.json` alias — `bun .github/skills/bench/bench-vs-tag.ts` is the contract.
- fallow (`bunx fallow`, not a repo dep) is configured in `.fallowrc.json`. Published **subpath entry points** MUST be listed under `entry` or every adapter feature hook reads as a dead file (`libs/grid-{react,vue}/src/features/*.ts`, `libs/grid-angular/src/lib/{directives,interfaces}/index.ts`) — fallow reads neither package `exports` nor `build.lib.entry`. `ignorePatterns`: `libs/themes/**`, `libs/*/node_modules/**`; `ignoreDependencies`: `lightningcss` (build-only). `unused_class_members` hits are public plugin API, #370 duck-typed seams, or calls through `#private` manager fields — triage, don't delete.
